headline: LLM agents gain verification gates for auditable biological analysis workflows
label: Verified Llm Research Agents
summary: Biology-focused LLM agents are being built with provenance checks, gated outputs and independent confirmation to make automated analyses auditable.
synthesis: The shared thread is verification built into LLM agents that execute biological analysis rather than only generating text. Plato-Bio adds provenance tracking, citation checks and publication gates to novelty screening. CogEEGAgent uses deterministic gates to control analysis release and held-out confirmation to curb false positives in cognitive EEG on MNE-Python. MetaClaw maps requests to registered workflows with isolated downstream analyses for metagenomic data. What is new is constraining agent behavior through registered workflows, gated outputs and independent confirmation. FEV proposes an audit framework for such workflows. All items are preprints with descriptive evidence; no quantitative performance results are reported.
